native_validation_v2.summary: Native AF13 v2 compares exact independently planned subjects and source-owned worker receipts; current private/recorder/owner permissions, reservation-after-expectations, source heads, receipt identity, criteria/freshness and synthetic classification are checked. Supplied actuals and legacy v1 history cannot establish current operational execution. Pilot v2 links existing AF13 owner decisions without copying authority or circular pack hashes. Native application/cold proofs bind actual PostgreSQL and attachment recovery evidence; stale/tampered bytes hold current use. Observation-process build identity is distinguished from the unverified original executor build. No external/business-oracle/live-pilot acceptance is implied.

private_policy_impact.summary: Six private/document policy-impact adapters extend the closed registry from10 to16: publication effects, private F01 projections/reviewed drafts, HR disclosures, payroll working versions and BU work. Native private/participant rights are checked before metadata, lookahead pagination or snapshot budgets. Metadata contains IDs/hashes/status/review heads, without financial/staff bodies. Canonical full-recipient receipt lookup distinguishes committed, pending/uncertain and partial/mismatched receipt conflicts. NOWAIT publication job locks and ordered source/participant case locks prevent competing-worker/grant races. Current successors stale the engineering assessment. SSR choices/reports and bounded A04 reuse these services; engineering acceptance never copies a business approval, renews HR consent/retention, publishes or retries. Actual native cold archive preserves publication-impact history with inactive restored users, no grants and quarantine.

role_eligibility_v2.summary: D05 role-assignment/v2 configures exact per-person role bundles and aware half-open eligibility windows through the existing component/version lifecycle. V1 nominations and synthetic fixture behavior remain supported; absent/expired operational eligibility holds that person only. Draft UI, strict schema/collection validators, fresh active principal checks, local read adapter and bounded A04 are implemented. Current grants and all native independent human controls remain mandatory. Scoped adoption never installs action grants; stored-origin access is checked even for unavailable resolution. Emergency GLPI v2 explicitly selects current_D05_bundle for shared Security/Engineering roles and requires fresh current decisions, without adding gates or granting deployment/payment authority. Actual native archive preserves v2 declarations as inert history with inactive restored people/no grants/quarantine.

native_publication_guard.summary: Native document.publish uses the same read-only guard as actual controlled publication reservation. Exact source/version/sender/review/recipient/template/retention/prior-reservation preconditions are shared, not simulated. Source-aware ID-only form and metadata headers preserve Finance/private interfaces; no titles/bodies/financial metrics returned. Current receipt lookup distinguishes verified internal delivery from absent/conflicting evidence; already-reserved versions stay held for source-owned recovery. Finance internal output keeps native Finance review with no added PMO gate. Typed binding validators enforce exact bounded integers; forward SQL closes selected operation/person/argument/source-case identities with negative and valid controls. SSR/engineering review/guard observation never creates a publication or job. Native AF13 publication, private impact, runtime workers and actual archive/inert recovery preserve the connected path.

native_authority_guard.summary: Native role.decision.evaluate calls actual decision_authority with explicit role/action/delegated variants; no business approval or action grant is created. Current V2 nominated principals now match delegated authority and must retain qualification. Decision-delegation/v2 adds an exact combined delegate-role eligibility/window; missing/expired/mismatched eligibility holds delegated use while unrelated own roles remain available. Legacy synthetic/single-role delegation remains supported. Draft UI, explicit-offset configuration time, source-aware read adapter and variant-aware A04 are implemented. Closed SQL includes boolean/action/role variants with negative and valid controls. Actual delegated document review, current-grant concurrency and scoped-origin revocation prove service boundaries. Native archive preserves V2 declarations/role guard metadata as inert history with inactive restored people, no grants and quarantine.

native_clock_guard.summary: Native workflow.clock.evaluate reuses the actual action deadline calculator with exact recorded meeting/assignment inputs and original meeting version. Elapsed rules require only anchor/deadline configuration; working-day variants retain timezone/calendar requirements. Legacy selected anchors remain usable only without inventing missing inputs. Reassessment is base-due-only and never changes stored commitments, pause extensions, ownership or action authority. Typed binding UI, same-case closed SQL, authorized source adapter and A04 explanations are implemented. Tests exercise current/terminal/stale states, conditional policy holds, meeting corrections, legacy evidence, SQL negative/positive controls and reviewed evidence/recovery history.

native_release_evaluation_guards.summary: Native payment.assess and hypercare.evaluate previews reuse shared actual domain preconditions/calculations. Payment assessment preserves UNKNOWN/missing basis and separate expectation status; hypercare preserves unknown/failed/qualified criteria. No assessment, exception decision, waiver, reservation, deployment or closure effect is created by previews. Current source access precedes lookup. Typed binding UI, closed same-case SQL, independent review and A04 explanations are connected to source/policy freshness. Native recording services call the same extracted functions and retain transaction locks/evidence/independent controls. Real PostgreSQL tests cover native results, source privacy, UI/CSRF, policy successors, current grants and SQL rejection with valid controls.

native_cash_guards.summary: Native receipt.verify and receipt.allocate previews now share actual cash preconditions. Pure authority facts allow autocommit observation; native effects retain case/grant locks, role/source/precision/independence checks, exact retry identity and both cash/open-invoice capacity. No money facts are created by previews. Typed ID-only UI, exact evidence kinds, closed same-case/type/decimal/key SQL, source/position hashes, independent review and A04 are connected. Tests cover source access before lookup, policy holds versus capture, verification/allocation effects and retries, reversals, precision/capacity, UI/CSRF, SQL negative/valid controls and concurrency; Actual corrected-lot and competing successor tests retain lineage. Numeric-leading native operation IDs are preserved by typed/SQL bindings via forward policy0016; policy0015 is unchanged. The oversized-value probe was already rejected by the existing source parser; no duplicate financial validator or new owner policy remains.

staff_layout.summary: Rebuilt the shared server-rendered staff interface: persistent sidebar, grouped workspace areas, compact overview and current-access Finance discovery, useful search, personal work with action descriptions, document inbox, audience reports, intake and sign-in. Removed repeated sample badges, revision banners and development framing from primary copy; applied plain static wording across workflow templates and balanced section cards across41 workflow templates. Record-specific access, native forms, CSRF, stale revisions, exact evidence and policy holds remain. Generated sample titles have presentation aliases only; actual names, records and historical evidence are unchanged. Technical/source details remain available for review instead of leading the screen. No new identity, policy value, schema or financial effect.
